key: "The Lord's Blessing"\n Read?
en: "The Lord's Blessing"\n Read?
ja: 「主の祝福」\n 読みますか?

key: "From the darkness,
en: "From the darkness,
ja: 「闇より、

key: From stardust,
en: From stardust,
ja: 星くずより、

key: From the memories of eons passed and visions of eons yet to come,
en: From the memories of eons passed and visions of eons yet to come,
ja: 過ぎ去りしえいごうの記憶と、来たるべきえいごうの幻より、

key: From these things did the Lord Arceus mold the heavens, the Earth, and all that walk upon it."\n -- Arceus 2-4
en: From these things did the Lord Arceus mold the heavens, the Earth, and all that walk upon it."\n -- Arceus 2-4
ja: これらより、主なるアルセウスは天と地と、その上を歩むすべてのものを創り給うた。」\n -- アルセウス書 2章4節

key: "In Worship of the Lord"\n Read?
en: "In Worship of the Lord"\n Read?
ja: 「主への礼拝」\n 読みますか?

key: Praise the Lord.
en: Praise the Lord.
ja: 主をたたえよ。

key: Worship the Lord.
en: Worship the Lord.
ja: 主を崇めよ。

key: Bequeath thy soul unto the Lord, that he might cleanse thee of thy impurity.
en: Bequeath thy soul unto the Lord, that he might cleanse thee of thy impurity.
ja: なんじの魂を主にささげよ、さすれば主はなんじのけがれを清め給うであろう。

key: "All shall be white before the eyes of the Lord Arceus."\n -- Arceus 16-5
en: "All shall be white before the eyes of the Lord Arceus."\n -- Arceus 16-5
ja: 「すべては、主なるアルセウスの御目の前にて白く清められん。」\n -- アルセウス書 16章5節

key: "Remnants of the New World" \nRead?
en: "Remnants of the New World" \nRead?
ja: 「新世界の名残」\n 読みますか?

key: When our Lord Arceus had at last finished crafting the world from stardust, what then should the divine do with the remnants of immateria?
en: When our Lord Arceus had at last finished crafting the world from stardust, what then should the divine do with the remnants of immateria?
ja: 主なるアルセウスが星くずより世界を創り終えし時、神はその形なき名残をいかにすべきか。

key: These forgotten fragments of reality have been sealed away in the Sacred Land.
en: These forgotten fragments of reality have been sealed away in the Sacred Land.
ja: これら忘れられし現実の断片は、聖なる地に封じられた。

key: Behind stone doors, four pillars of light bind the New World to a shadow of our own.
en: Behind stone doors, four pillars of light bind the New World to a shadow of our own.
ja: 石の扉の奥、四本の光の柱が、新世界をわれらの影に結びつけている。

key: Yet, the sleeping legend remains.
en: Yet, the sleeping legend remains.
ja: されど、眠れる伝説はなお残る。

key: "The Lord Arceus shall come again. The New World, too, shall be Reborn."\n -- Arceus 38-27
en: "The Lord Arceus shall come again. The New World, too, shall be Reborn."\n -- Arceus 38-27
ja: 「主なるアルセウスは再び来たり給う。新世界もまた、生まれ変わるであろう。」\n -- アルセウス書 38章27節

key: "Arceus' Call"\nRead?
en: "Arceus' Call"\nRead?
ja: 「アルセウスの呼び声」\n 読みますか?

key: "Our Father, fallen from heaven,\nHonored be thy name,
en: "Our Father, fallen from heaven,\nHonored be thy name,
ja: 「天より堕ちし我らが父よ、\n御名の尊ばれんことを、

key: Your kingdom, born,\nThis world, forlorn
en: Your kingdom, born,\nThis world, forlorn
ja: なんじの王国、生まれ、\nこの世界、見捨てられ、

key: The New World shall become thy heaven." -- Arceus 7-1
en: The New World shall become thy heaven." -- Arceus 7-1
ja: 新世界こそが、なんじの天となるであろう。」-- アルセウス書 7章1節

key: "Charge of the Faithful"\n Read?
en: "Charge of the Faithful"\n Read?
ja: 「信徒への使命」\n 読みますか?

key: So be it the duty of all, human and Pokémon alike:
en: So be it the duty of all, human and Pokémon alike:
ja: されば、人もポケモンも等しくその務めを負うべし。

key: "Bestow light upon thy brethren; give sight to the blind and life to the lost.
en: "Bestow light upon thy brethren; give sight to the blind and life to the lost.
ja: 「なんじの同胞に光を与えよ。盲いし者に視力を、見失いし者に命を与えよ。

key: Arceus shall grant thee favor in the New World." -- Arceus 12-3
en: Arceus shall grant thee favor in the New World." -- Arceus 12-3
ja: アルセウスは、新世界にてなんじに恵みを授けるであろう。」-- アルセウス書 12章3節

key: "Light's End"\n Read?
en: "Light's End"\n Read?
ja: 「光の果て」\n 読みますか?

key: "So kind was light to show us mercy,
en: "So kind was light to show us mercy,
ja: 「かくも優しき光は、われらに慈悲を示し、

key: That in its shade we festered heresy.
en: That in its shade we festered heresy.
ja: その陰にて、われらは異端を育んだ。

key: Twixt three stones, each shaded void,
en: Twixt three stones, each shaded void,
ja: 三つの石のはざま、それぞれの陰なる虚空に、

key: Six pillars shone, their truth deployed:
en: Six pillars shone, their truth deployed:
ja: 六本の柱が輝き、その真理を示した。

key: Emerald, Crimson, Violet, Gold,
en: Emerald, Crimson, Violet, Gold,
ja: ひすい、深紅、紫、金、

key: Azure and Ivory seal as told.
en: Azure and Ivory seal as told.
ja: そう、そして象牙が、語られしごとく封じる。

key: Take heed of its prison, o ye foolish men,
en: Take heed of its prison, o ye foolish men,
ja: おお、愚かなる者どもよ、その独房に気をつけよ、

key: For the blackest beast lies at light's end."
en: For the blackest beast lies at light's end."
ja: 光の果てには、最も黒き獣が横たわるゆえに。」

key: The notebook has no title. \nRead?
en: The notebook has no title. \nRead?
ja: そのノートに題名はない。\n 読みますか?

key: "Place faith in the Lord, and so shall he in you.
en: "Place faith in the Lord, and so shall he in you.
ja: 「主に信を置け、さすれば主もまたなんじに信を置き給う。

key: Place animosity upon the Lord, and so shall he upon you.
en: Place animosity upon the Lord, and so shall he upon you.
ja: 主に敵意を向けよ、さすれば主もまたなんじに敵意を向け給う。

key: This lesson is not an easy one to learn. Some will never fully grasp it. Many will only pretend to.
en: This lesson is not an easy one to learn. Some will never fully grasp it. Many will only pretend to.
ja: この教えは容易に学べるものではありません。決して完全には理解できない者もいれば、理解したふりをするだけの者も多くいます。

key: Today, I would like to share with you the story of how I came to learn this.
en: Today, I would like to share with you the story of how I came to learn this.
ja: 今日は、私がこれをどのように学ぶに至ったか、その物語を皆さんにお話ししたいと思います。

key: I was born to the purpose of Arceus, but I was born blind.
en: I was born to the purpose of Arceus, but I was born blind.
ja: 私はアルセウスの目的のために生まれましたが、盲目として生まれました。

key: Growing up as a boy with no sight in a world like this is no easy task, but of course, I learned to take care of myself.
en: Growing up as a boy with no sight in a world like this is no easy task, but of course, I learned to take care of myself.
ja: このような世界で視力のない少年として育つのは容易なことではありませんでしたが、もちろん、私は自分の身の回りのことを自分でこなせるようになりました。

key: For some time, that was the only thing I could be proud of.
en: For some time, that was the only thing I could be proud of.
ja: しばらくの間、それだけが私の誇れることでした。

key: My family was an old one, back from the days when Reborn City was no more than a village around a crater, both of which are since lost underground.
en: My family was an old one, back from the days when Reborn City was no more than a village around a crater, both of which are since lost underground.
ja: 私の一族は古く、リボーンシティがまだクレーターを囲む一つの村に過ぎなかった時代――その村もクレーターも、今では地下に失われてしまいましたが――にまで遡ります。

key: When first Arceus' birthplace crashed upon our world, one family set about enshrining it.
en: When first Arceus' birthplace crashed upon our world, one family set about enshrining it.
ja: アルセウスの生誕の地が初めてこの世界に落下した時、ある一族がそれをまつることを始めました。

key: They would protect it from the world, so that its purity might remain ever intact.
en: They would protect it from the world, so that its purity might remain ever intact.
ja: 彼らはそれを世界から守り、その純潔が永遠に損なわれぬようにしたのです。

key: This was their life's calling.
en: This was their life's calling.
ja: それこそが、彼らの生涯の使命でした。

key: And this was not my family.
en: And this was not my family.
ja: そして、それは私の一族ではありませんでした。

key: Mine came years later, and, finding light in their purpose, swore to serve that family.
en: Mine came years later, and, finding light in their purpose, swore to serve that family.
ja: 私の一族は何年も後にやって来て、彼らの目的に光を見出し、その家に仕えることを誓ったのです。

key: So it came to be that each generation of my house served theirs.
en: So it came to be that each generation of my house served theirs.
ja: こうして、私の家は代々、彼らの家に仕えるようになりました。

key: Until it came to me, a defective blind child, who would do more harm than good as a servant.
en: Until it came to me, a defective blind child, who would do more harm than good as a servant.
ja: そしてそれは私にまで受け継がれましたが、私は欠陥のある盲目の子供で、従者としてはむしろ害になるような存在でした。

key: The man to whom I should have been sworn was born some ten years after me.
en: The man to whom I should have been sworn was born some ten years after me.
ja: 私が仕えるはずだった相手は、私よりおよそ十年後に生まれました。

key: We know him as Solaris.
en: We know him as Solaris.
ja: 私たちは彼をソラリスと呼んでいます。

key: He was a raucous youth, never quite satisfied with his life's charge of protecting an old monument.
en: He was a raucous youth, never quite satisfied with his life's charge of protecting an old monument.
ja: 彼は騒々しい若者で、古い遺跡を守るという生涯の務めに、決して満足することがありませんでした。

key: As I understand, for most of his life he resented this purpose, lashing out, as many of the young do, against Arceus.
en: As I understand, for most of his life he resented this purpose, lashing out, as many of the young do, against Arceus.
ja: 私の理解する限り、彼は人生の大半においてこの目的を恨み、多くの若者がそうするように、アルセウスに反抗していました。

key: I could understand his feelings.
en: I could understand his feelings.
ja: 私には彼の気持ちが理解できました。

key: Why, I asked myself, if Arceus is so great, should he have made me this way?
en: Why, I asked myself, if Arceus is so great, should he have made me this way?
ja: なぜ、と私は自問しました。アルセウスがそれほど偉大なら、なぜ私をこんな風に作ったのだろうか、と。

key: Why did I have to suffer? Why did I have to serve?
en: Why did I have to suffer? Why did I have to serve?
ja: なぜ私は苦しまねばならないのか。なぜ私は仕えねばならないのか。

key: As it turned out, Solaris would be the one to show me the answer.
en: As it turned out, Solaris would be the one to show me the answer.
ja: 結局のところ、その答えを私に示してくれたのはソラリスでした。

key: A failed vassal, I dared not approach him, and though our fathers were close, mine never allowed me to see the young master as I was growing up.
en: A failed vassal, I dared not approach him, and though our fathers were close, mine never allowed me to see the young master as I was growing up.
ja: 失格の従者である私は、彼に近づこうとはしませんでした。私たちの父親同士は親しかったものの、私の父は私が育つあいだ、若君に会わせようとはしませんでした。

key: It was not until I was well into a miserable adulthood that we first met.
en: It was not until I was well into a miserable adulthood that we first met.
ja: 私たちが初めて出会ったのは、私がすでにみじめな大人になってからのことでした。

key: Solaris knew of me, of course.
en: Solaris knew of me, of course.
ja: もちろん、ソラリスは私のことを知っていました。

key: He knew my family was due by lineage to serve his, and he had heard of the blind man, whom others had deemed unfit for his presence.
en: He knew my family was due by lineage to serve his, and he had heard of the blind man, whom others had deemed unfit for his presence.
ja: 私の一族が血統によって彼の一族に仕えるべき身であることを知っていましたし、周囲から彼の前に出るには不適格だとみなされていたあの盲目の男のことも耳にしていたのです。

key: And, as he did with all things, he rebelled.
en: And, as he did with all things, he rebelled.
ja: そして、彼はいつものように、それに反抗しました。

key: He offered his hand to me.
en: He offered his hand to me.
ja: 彼は私に手を差し伸べてくれました。

key: I took it with an oath of servitude.
en: I took it with an oath of servitude.
ja: 私は忠誠の誓いと共に、その手を取りました。

key: This was not a chance I should have been given.
en: This was not a chance I should have been given.
ja: それは、本来私に与えられるはずのない機会でした。

key: So, I pushed myself as hard as I could to try and have value to my master.
en: So, I pushed myself as hard as I could to try and have value to my master.
ja: だからこそ、私は主のために価値ある存在になろうと、できる限り自分を追い込みました。

key: But both of us were lordless, lawless men.
en: But both of us were lordless, lawless men.
ja: しかし私たち二人は、共に主なき、法なき男でした。

key: He had no purpose to serve but fighting his own, and we found common ground therein.
en: He had no purpose to serve but fighting his own, and we found common ground therein.
ja: 彼には自らの内なるものと戦う以外に仕えるべき目的がなく、私たちはそこに共通点を見出したのです。

key: Nevertheless, Arceus would reach us eventually.
en: Nevertheless, Arceus would reach us eventually.
ja: それでも、アルセウスはいずれ私たちのもとへと届くことになります。

key: For many years, Solaris questioned, 'Just what does the meteor need to be protected from?'
en: For many years, Solaris questioned, 'Just what does the meteor need to be protected from?'
ja: 何年ものあいだ、ソラリスは問い続けていました。「そもそも、あのいん石は何から守られる必要があるんだ?」と。

key: It was already locked up with the four crystal keys.
en: It was already locked up with the four crystal keys.
ja: それはすでに、四つのクリスタルのカギによって封じられていたのです。

key: And who would want to defile some old rock anyway?
en: And who would want to defile some old rock anyway?
ja: そもそも、古い岩なんぞを汚したい者などいるだろうか、と。

key: This was a lesson he learned the hard way, when his parents were both killed by an assailant seeking those very keys.
en: This was a lesson he learned the hard way, when his parents were both killed by an assailant seeking those very keys.
ja: だがこれは、彼が苦い形で学ぶことになった教訓でした。両親が、まさにそのカギを狙う襲撃者の手にかかって、共に命を落としたのです。

key: The young master was too late to save them, but just in time to avenge them.
en: The young master was too late to save them, but just in time to avenge them.
ja: 若君は二人を救うには遅すぎましたが、かたきを討つには間に合いました。

key: So he bludgeoned the man who had claimed the keys until his arms were too battered to hold on to them anymore,
en: So he bludgeoned the man who had claimed the keys until his arms were too battered to hold on to them anymore,
ja: 彼はカギを奪った男を、その腕がもはやカギを握っていられぬほど打ちのめし、

key: And until his lips were too loose to keep secrets.
en: And until his lips were too loose to keep secrets.
ja: その口がもはや秘密を守れぬほどまで、痛めつけたのです。

key: 'Why?!', Solaris cried, over and over.
en: 'Why?!', Solaris cried, over and over.
ja: 「なぜだ?!」ソラリスは何度も何度も叫びました。

key: The assailant would tell him rumours he had never believed, of a great power locked within the meteor, lying dormant for years.
en: The assailant would tell him rumours he had never believed, of a great power locked within the meteor, lying dormant for years.
ja: 襲撃者は、彼自身信じてもいなかったうわさ――いん石の中に封じられ、何年も眠り続ける大いなる力についてのうわさ――を語りました。

key: Whether it was true or not, the thief believed it, and so he grasped at it.
en: Whether it was true or not, the thief believed it, and so he grasped at it.
ja: それが真実かどうかはともかく、その盗人はそれを信じ、それゆえに手を伸ばしたのです。

key: 'Why?!', Solaris continued to cry.
en: 'Why?!', Solaris continued to cry.
ja: 「なぜだ?!」ソラリスは叫び続けました。

key: And so he said, on and on until daybreak, thrashing against the culprit's body for long after there was any soul still there to know it.
en: And so he said, on and on until daybreak, thrashing against the culprit's body for long after there was any soul still there to know it.
ja: 彼はそう言い続け、夜明けまで、もはや魂が宿っていないとうに死んだ男の体を、ずっと打ち続けていました。

key: He was no longer asking anyone other than himself.
en: He was no longer asking anyone other than himself.
ja: もはや彼は、自分以外の誰かに問うていたのではありませんでした。

key: Why had he refused to listen to his parents?
en: Why had he refused to listen to his parents?
ja: なぜ両親の言葉に耳を貸さなかったのか。

key: Why had he not seen the danger they were in?
en: Why had he not seen the danger they were in?
ja: なぜ彼らが危険にさらされていることに気づかなかったのか。

key: Why could he not save them?
en: Why could he not save them?
ja: なぜ彼らを救えなかったのか。

key: And believing that he had led to the death of his own parents,
en: And believing that he had led to the death of his own parents,
ja: そして、自らが両親の死を招いたのだと信じたその時、

key: For the first time, he strode forward to meet his life's purpose.
en: For the first time, he strode forward to meet his life's purpose.
ja: 彼は初めて、自らの生涯の目的に向かって歩み出したのです。

key: The Lord will punish those who lack faith.
en: The Lord will punish those who lack faith.
ja: 主は、信仰なき者を罰し給う。

key: This is what is to be learned from Solaris' tale.
en: This is what is to be learned from Solaris' tale.
ja: これが、ソラリスの物語から学ぶべきことです。

key: My own awakening came a number of years later.
en: My own awakening came a number of years later.
ja: 私自身の目覚めは、それから何年も後に訪れました。

key: When my master walked the path of the Lord, so naturally did I have to as well.
en: When my master walked the path of the Lord, so naturally did I have to as well.
ja: 私の主が主の道を歩まれた時、当然、私もまたそうしなければなりませんでした。

key: I would follow my friend, but in regards to faith, my service was half-hearted.
en: I would follow my friend, but in regards to faith, my service was half-hearted.
ja: 私は友としての彼にはついていきましたが、信仰に関しては、私の奉仕は中途半端なものでした。

key: Solaris recognized this, and one day confronted me about it.
en: Solaris recognized this, and one day confronted me about it.
ja: ソラリスはそれに気づき、ある日、そのことで私に向き合いました。

key: After some discussion, he offered the Emerald Key he should have himself safeguarded with his life, in return for my faith.
en: After some discussion, he offered the Emerald Key he should have himself safeguarded with his life, in return for my faith.
ja: 話し合いの末、彼は本来自らの命に懸けて守るべきエメラルドのカギを、私の信仰と引き換えに差し出したのです。

key: He wished for me not just to serve him, but to personally share his burden.
en: He wished for me not just to serve him, but to personally share his burden.
ja: 彼は、私に単に仕えてほしいのではなく、自らの重荷を共に分かち合ってほしいと望んでいたのです。

key: I accepted this, and resolved to place every ounce of my trust in the Lord, and my friend.
en: I accepted this, and resolved to place every ounce of my trust in the Lord, and my friend.
ja: 私はそれを受け入れ、主に、そして友に、あらん限りの信頼を置く決意をしました。

key: When I awoke the next morning, the key still clutched tightly against my chest, I was assaulted by a phenomenon I had never experienced before.
en: When I awoke the next morning, the key still clutched tightly against my chest, I was assaulted by a phenomenon I had never experienced before.
ja: 翌朝、目覚めた時、カギをまだ胸にしっかりと握りしめたまま、私はそれまで経験したことのない現象に襲われました。

key: Lights, dazzling colors, shapes so blurred I could scarcely recognize the forms I was so used to navigating around otherwise.
en: Lights, dazzling colors, shapes so blurred I could scarcely recognize the forms I was so used to navigating around otherwise.
ja: 光、まばゆい色彩、ぼやけた形――ふだん手探りで慣れ親しんでいたはずの輪郭さえ、ほとんど認識できないほどでした。

key: Sight.
en: Sight.
ja: 視力です。

key: There are no words to describe the feeling of seeing my master's face for the first time.
en: There are no words to describe the feeling of seeing my master's face for the first time.
ja: 主の顔を初めて見た時の感覚を言い表す言葉はありません。

key: Or that of seeing my own face.
en: Or that of seeing my own face.
ja: 自分自身の顔を見た時の感覚も、同じです。

key: That of finally being able to really understand what words like 'golden' and 'light' meant.
en: That of finally being able to really understand what words like 'golden' and 'light' meant.
ja: ついに「金色」や「光」といった言葉の意味を、本当に理解できるようになった時の感覚も。

key: Before, they were just dreams, but I knew that the Lord-- and my trust in him-- had made it real.
en: Before, they were just dreams, but I knew that the Lord-- and my trust in him-- had made it real.
ja: それまでは、ただの夢に過ぎませんでした。しかし私は、主が――そして主への私の信頼が――それを現実にしてくださったのだと知りました。

key: The Lord will reward those with true faith.
en: The Lord will reward those with true faith.
ja: 主は、真の信仰を持つ者に報い給う。

key: It has been many years since then.
en: It has been many years since then.
ja: あれから、もう何年も経ちました。

key: I am constantly assaulted with sorrow and worry for the sake of my daughter, and for his son both.
en: I am constantly assaulted with sorrow and worry for the sake of my daughter, and for his son both.
ja: 私は、我が娘のため、そして彼の息子のため、絶えず悲しみと不安に襲われています。

key: I do not wish them to receive any such punishment as my friend did.
en: I do not wish them to receive any such punishment as my friend did.
ja: 私の友が受けたような罰を、彼らが受けることは望みません。

key: I wish them both all the blessings of the Lord they have turned from.
en: I wish them both all the blessings of the Lord they have turned from.
ja: 二人が背を向けてしまった主のあらゆる祝福が、二人にありますように。

key: I fear, too, for each of you.
en: I fear, too, for each of you.
ja: そして、皆さん一人ひとりのことも、私は案じています。

key: Though less so, than for each of the heretics above.
en: Though less so, than for each of the heretics above.
ja: もっとも、先ほど述べた異端者たちほどではありませんが。

key: The city's miserable state is no doubt a result of its divergence from the Lord.
en: The city's miserable state is no doubt a result of its divergence from the Lord.
ja: この街の惨めな状態は、間違いなく主から離れたことの結果でしょう。

key: Therefore, I implore you,
en: Therefore, I implore you,
ja: それゆえ、皆さんにお願いいたします。

key: Please, trust in Arceus.
en: Please, trust in Arceus.
ja: どうか、アルセウスを信じてください。

key: Please, guide others to trust in Arceus.
en: Please, guide others to trust in Arceus.
ja: どうか、他の人々もアルセウスを信じるよう導いてください。

key: Under the Lord's light, may we all see bright futures.
en: Under the Lord's light, may we all see bright futures.
ja: 主の光のもと、われら皆が明るい未来を見られますように。

key: Thank you."
en: Thank you."
ja: ありがとうございました。」

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 29!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 29!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説29を手に入れた!

key: Info on Holy Field now available!
en: Info on Holy Field now available!
ja: ホーリーフィールドの情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: LUNA: Well met once more, \PN.
en: LUNA: Well met once more, \PN.
ja: ルナ: またお会いできて何よりです、\PN。

key: I, as well, had come to see what the matter was here.
en: I, as well, had come to see what the matter was here.
ja: わたしも、ここで何が起きているのか確かめに来ていたのです。

key: Loath as I am to admit due to long-tarnished memories, this place is one I'm yet beholden to in other ways.
en: Loath as I am to admit due to long-tarnished memories, this place is one I'm yet beholden to in other ways.
ja: 長らく色あせた記憶ゆえに認めたくはないのですが、この場所には、別の意味でまだ恩義があります。

key: I should not like to see it fall to total ruin; silence is quite enough.
en: I should not like to see it fall to total ruin; silence is quite enough.
ja: 完全に崩れ去るのを見たくはありません。静寂だけで十分ですから。

key: And yet, I find this door is closed to me.
en: And yet, I find this door is closed to me.
ja: それでも、この扉はわたしには閉ざされているようです。

key: Whatever wonders remain beyond it, they are not mine to access.
en: Whatever wonders remain beyond it, they are not mine to access.
ja: この先にどんな不思議が残っていようと、それはわたしが立ち入るべきものではありません。

key: This is quite new to me.
en: This is quite new to me.
ja: これは、わたしにとってかなり新鮮な感覚です。

key: But here you are, an answer to a question.
en: But here you are, an answer to a question.
ja: ですが、あなたがここにいる――それこそが、ある問いへの答えなのでしょう。

key: Unfiltering and unfaltering, may you find you fill your role as effectively as always you thus far have.
en: Unfiltering and unfaltering, may you find you fill your role as effectively as always you thus far have.
ja: ためらうことなく、ぶれることなく、これまでと変わらず自らの役目を果たされることを願っています。

key: LUNA: I suspect we'll both soon see just for what reasons I am unable to join you this time.
en: LUNA: I suspect we'll both soon see just for what reasons I am unable to join you this time.
ja: ルナ: 今回わたしが同行できない理由は、じきに二人とも知ることになると思います。

key: LUNA: Well, then.
en: LUNA: Well, then.
ja: ルナ: それでは。

key: It would appear the matter has decided itself settled.
en: It would appear the matter has decided itself settled.
ja: 事は自ずと解決したようですね。

key: And be it a twist of the mind, or a twist of time, I believe I have some inkling of what transpired beyond there.
en: And be it a twist of the mind, or a twist of time, I believe I have some inkling of what transpired beyond there.
ja: 心のいたずらか、時のいたずらか、あの先で何が起きたのか、わたしにも幾らか心当たりがあります。

key: A memory came to me not too long after you entered.
en: A memory came to me not too long after you entered.
ja: あなたが中に入られてからそう経たぬうちに、ある記憶がわたしのもとによみがえってきました。

key: I find myself unsure as to whether or not it was mine before.
en: I find myself unsure as to whether or not it was mine before.
ja: それが以前からわたしのものだったのかどうか、自分でも定かではありません。

key: TAKA: Oh, \PN?
en: TAKA: Oh, \PN?
ja: タカ: あ、\PN?

key: I heard a noise coming from here, but if it's just you--
en: I heard a noise coming from here, but if it's just you--
ja: ここから物音が聞こえた気がしたけど、君だけなら――

key: O-oh.
en: O-oh.
ja: あ……あ。

key: Um, hi Luna.
en: Um, hi Luna.
ja: えっと、やあ、ルナ。

key: LUNA: Greetings, Young Master.
en: LUNA: Greetings, Young Master.
ja: ルナ: ごきげんよう、若様。

key: How may we be of assistance?
en: How may we be of assistance?
ja: 何かお手伝いできることでも?

key: TAKA: Um, no. You don't need to...
en: TAKA: Um, no. You don't need to...
ja: タカ: いや、あの。別に、そんな必要は……

key: I was just... um, trying to see...
en: I was just... um, trying to see...
ja: ただ……その、確かめてみようとしただけで……

key: Uh, I heard there was an Anomaly or something here.
en: Uh, I heard there was an Anomaly or something here.
ja: えっと、ここに「アノマリー」とかいうのが出たって聞いたから。

key: I was gonna see if I could pitch in and help clean it up.
en: I was gonna see if I could pitch in and help clean it up.
ja: 何か手伝えることがないか、片付けを手伝おうかと思って。

key: Do my part, or whatever...
en: Do my part, or whatever...
ja: 自分にできることを、とか、まあそんな感じで……

key: LUNA: Of course.
en: LUNA: Of course.
ja: ルナ: なるほど。

key: Admirably intentioned, Young Master, but as far as anyone can tell, the matter has been entirely resolved by \PN already.
en: Admirably intentioned, Young Master, but as far as anyone can tell, the matter has been entirely resolved by \PN already.
ja: ご立派な心がけですが、若様、見たところ、その件はすでに\PNによってすっかり解決されているようですよ。

key: TAKA: Right...
en: TAKA: Right...
ja: タカ: だよね……

key: Uh, well.
en: Uh, well.
ja: ええと、じゃあ。

key: I'll just be... going, then.
en: I'll just be... going, then.
ja: 僕はもう……行くよ。

key: LUNA: Young Master.
en: LUNA: Young Master.
ja: ルナ: 若様。

key: TAKA: Please... stop calling me that.
en: TAKA: Please... stop calling me that.
ja: タカ: お願いだから……その呼び方、やめてくれよ。

key: All of that is over with now.
en: All of that is over with now.
ja: あれはもう、全部終わったことなんだ。

key: I want it to be over with now.
en: I want it to be over with now.
ja: 今こそ終わりにしたいんだよ。

key: You're your own person now.
en: You're your own person now.
ja: 君はもう、君自身の人間なんだから。

key: Just-- just another girl.
en: Just-- just another girl.
ja: ただの――ただの一人の女の子として。

key: Please, act like it?
en: Please, act like it?
ja: それらしく振る舞ってくれないか?

key: LUNA: ...Of course.
en: LUNA: ...Of course.
ja: ルナ: ……承知しました。

key: Understood.
en: Understood.
ja: かしこまりました

key: TAKA: ...Soooo, yeah.
en: TAKA: ...Soooo, yeah.
ja: タカ: ……えっと、まあ、そんな感じで。

key: I'm... just gonna go.
en: I'm... just gonna go.
ja: 僕は……もう行くよ。

key: Uh, sorry about this, \PN. I'll... see you around?
en: Uh, sorry about this, \PN. I'll... see you around?
ja: あの、ごめんね、\PN。また……そのうち会おう?

key: LUNA: This was a misstep on my part.
en: LUNA: This was a misstep on my part.
ja: ルナ: 今のは、わたしの過ちでした。

key: For a moment, I was living in the past.
en: For a moment, I was living in the past.
ja: 一瞬、わたしは過去に生きてしまっていました。

key: He did not want me, after all.
en: He did not want me, after all.
ja: 結局、彼はわたしを望んではいなかったのですね。

key: That is why I had to find a new Master.
en: That is why I had to find a new Master.
ja: だからこそ、新しいご主人様を見つけなければならなかったのです。

key: To live my life for the benefit of others is simply how I was raised.
en: To live my life for the benefit of others is simply how I was raised.
ja: 他者のために生きること――それが、わたしの育てられ方そのものなのです。

key: It is what seems most sensible to me.
en: It is what seems most sensible to me.
ja: それが、わたしにとって最も筋の通ったことのように思えます。

key: I believe many of us would be benefitted were more people willing to accept as much;
en: I believe many of us would be benefitted were more people willing to accept as much;
ja: もっと多くの人がそれを受け入れる気になれば、わたしたちの多くが救われるように思います。

key: Both the role and the service itself.
en: Both the role and the service itself.
ja: 役割そのものも、奉仕そのものも。

key: Neither is an easy burden to bear.
en: Neither is an easy burden to bear.
ja: どちらも、担うにたやすい重荷ではありません。

key: I will be on my way now.
en: I will be on my way now.
ja: では、わたしはこれで失礼いたします。

key: Though I feel remorse that you've had to witness much of what you have, I thank you for your service to the region as ever.
en: Though I feel remorse that you've had to witness much of what you have, I thank you for your service to the region as ever.
ja: あなたに多くのことを目撃させてしまったことは心苦しく思いますが、いつもこの地方のために尽くしてくださって感謝しています。

key: Until we meet again.
en: Until we meet again.
ja: またお会いしましょう。

key: I suppose this might suggest something to us about the ebb and flow of causes and effects,
en: I suppose this might suggest something to us about the ebb and flow of causes and effects,
ja: これは、原因と結果の満ち引きについて、わたしたちに何かを示唆しているのかもしれません。

key: But I find myself rather too consumed with lamentations to unfold all of that just now...
en: But I find myself rather too consumed with lamentations to unfold all of that just now...
ja: ですが今は、嘆きに心を奪われすぎて、それを解き明かす余裕がありません……

key: First, if someone truly had to have seen what I suspect you might have just then, I'm not sure I'd have preferred it be you.
en: First, if someone truly had to have seen what I suspect you might have just then, I'm not sure I'd have preferred it be you.
ja: まず、もし先ほどわたしが察したものを本当に誰かに見られねばならなかったのなら、それがあなたであってほしかったかどうかは分かりません。

key: No offense is meant, of course-- perhaps it is even rather more like flattery.
en: No offense is meant, of course-- perhaps it is even rather more like flattery.
ja: もちろん、悪気があるわけではありません――むしろ、褒め言葉に近いくらいです。

key: Many of us have histories of which we are not proud.
en: Many of us have histories of which we are not proud.
ja: わたしたちの多くには、誇れない過去があるものですから。

key: And secondly-- more pressingly...
en: And secondly-- more pressingly...
ja: そして二つ目――より差し迫った話ですが……

key: Well, this is quite a lonely place after all.
en: Well, this is quite a lonely place after all.
ja: やはり、ここはずいぶんと寂しい場所ですね。

key: Lonelier still for the fact that I have failed in my charge.
en: Lonelier still for the fact that I have failed in my charge.
ja: わたしが自らの務めを果たせなかったという事実が、なおのこと寂しさを募らせます。

key: Though on his command, through inaction I've allowed ruin to befall the very bloodline I was sworn to safeguard.
en: Though on his command, through inaction I've allowed ruin to befall the very bloodline I was sworn to safeguard.
ja: 彼の命に従いながらも、わたしは何もしないことで、守ると誓った血筋そのものに破滅を招いてしまいました。

key: There is much legacy that has been my undoing,
en: There is much legacy that has been my undoing,
ja: わたしを破滅させたものには、多くの因縁があります。

key: And it is this which will hang over my conscience for all my days remaining.
en: And it is this which will hang over my conscience for all my days remaining.
ja: そしてそれは、わたしの残りの日々すべてにわたって、良心に重くのしかかり続けるでしょう。

key: I pray my services elsewhere are enough to give purpose and life to an otherwise wholly failed steward.
en: I pray my services elsewhere are enough to give purpose and life to an otherwise wholly failed steward.
ja: 他の場所での奉仕が、この完全に失敗した従者に、せめて目的と生きる意味を与えてくれることを祈ります。

key: And, should they not be,
en: And, should they not be,
ja: そして、もしそうでなかったとしても、

key: That I can live up to his final command fully enough that he would not have regretted it.
en: That I can live up to his final command fully enough that he would not have regretted it.
ja: 彼が悔いを残さぬほどに、彼の最後の命令に応え続けられますように。

key: "Leave," he said.
en: "Leave," he said.
ja: 「行け」と彼は言いました。

key: "Go do whatever makes you happy."
en: "Go do whatever makes you happy."
ja: 「お前を幸せにすることを、何でもしに行くがいい」

key: "Is that an order?" I asked.
en: "Is that an order?" I asked.
ja: 「それは命令ですか?」とわたしは尋ねました。

key: He affirmed.
en: He affirmed.
ja: 彼はそうだと答えました。

key: Though generous, I believe it was an order not born from generosity.
en: Though generous, I believe it was an order not born from generosity.
ja: 寛大な命令ではありましたが、それは寛大さから生まれたものではなかったと思います。

key: Rather, desperation.
en: Rather, desperation.
ja: むしろ、絶望から生まれたものでした。

key: He perhaps wanted me to have what he could not.
en: He perhaps wanted me to have what he could not.
ja: 彼はおそらく、自分には得られなかったものを、わたしに与えたかったのでしょう。

key: But could he now-- if he were here to outlive the conflict of his lineage?
en: But could he now-- if he were here to outlive the conflict of his lineage?
ja: ですが今の彼なら――もし血筋の争いを生き延びてここにいたなら、どうだったでしょうか?

key: ???: --fInd oUT.
en: ???: --fInd oUT.
ja: ???: ――確かめてやル。

key: LUNA: Pardon? Did you... say something?
en: LUNA: Pardon? Did you... say something?
ja: ルナ: 失礼、何か……おっしゃいましたか?

key: ???: I wanT-- to fInd oUT!
en: ???: I wanT-- to fInd oUT!
ja: ???: 俺ハ――確かめたイんダ!

key: TAKA: I wanT oUT.
en: TAKA: I wanT oUT.
ja: タカ: 出タいんダ。

key: LUNA: Young Master...?
en: LUNA: Young Master...?
ja: ルナ: 若様……?

key: TAKA: I'm-- aliVE.
en: TAKA: I'm-- aliVE.
ja: タカ: 僕ハ――生きテる。

key: I feeL-- aliVE.
en: I feeL-- aliVE.
ja: 生きテるっテ感じガする。

key: LUNA: Is it truly...
en: LUNA: Is it truly...
ja: ルナ: それは本当に……

en: TAKA: ThesE wrEtched haLLwayS' stAle aIr neVer felT so goOD.
ja: タカ: このミジめナ廊下ノよどんダ空気ガ、こンなニ心地イいと感じタコとハなイ。

en: Let'S senD thiS prisOn wiTH iT.
ja: このロう獄モ、一緒ニ道連レにしヨう。

key: LUNA: You are possessed of this malignant energy.
en: LUNA: You are possessed of this malignant energy.
ja: ルナ: あなたは、この悪しきエネルギーにつかれているのですね。

key: TAKA: It'S noT so bAD.
en: TAKA: It'S noT so bAD.
ja: タカ: 悪クなイぜ。

key: LUNA: Essence of the New World, tainted by a virulent creator.
en: LUNA: Essence of the New World, tainted by a virulent creator.
ja: ルナ: 新世界の本質、それが凶悪な創造主によって汚されたもの。

key: It is bound to bring out the most destructive sides of those whom it envelops.
en: It is bound to bring out the most destructive sides of those whom it envelops.
ja: それに包まれた者の、最も破壊的な側面を引き出さずにはおかないものです。

key: TAKA: DesTructive?
en: TAKA: DesTructive?
ja: タカ: 破壊的、だト?

key: No-- I feeL greAT.
en: No-- I feeL greAT.
ja: いヤ――最高ノ気分ダぜ。

key: I don'T wanT to leT go oF thiS.
en: I don'T wanT to leT go oF thiS.
ja: コレを手放シたクなイ。

key: FoR the firsT timE-- seaRinG desIRE.
en: FoR the firsT timE-- seaRinG desIRE.
ja: 生マれテ初メテダ――燃エるヨうな欲望ってヤツハ。

key: LunA.
en: LunA.
ja: ルナ。

en: WoulD yoU stilL stanD witH me eveN noW?
ja: 今デも、まダ僕ノ側ニいテくれルカ?

key: BlacKened eSsenCe be dAmneD;
en: BlacKened eSsenCe be dAmneD;

en: LUNA: Your mind is altered by the blight; your heart is not at rest.
ja: ルナ: あなたの心は疫病に変えられ、あなたの魂は安らいでいません。

key: By all means, I should not dare to enable your impulses and wanton recklessness in this state.
en: By all means, I should not dare to enable your impulses and wanton recklessness in this state.
ja: 本来ならば、こんな状態のあなたの衝動と無謀な振る舞いを、あえて助長するべきではないのでしょう。

key: ...But I confess that in a heartbeat, I would.
en: ...But I confess that in a heartbeat, I would.
ja: ……ですが、白状しますと、一瞬の迷いもなくそうしてしまうでしょう。

key: No matter how many times you would send me away,
en: No matter how many times you would send me away,
ja: あなたに何度追い払われようとも、

key: My life will always be yours.
en: My life will always be yours.
ja: わたしの命は、いつもあなたのものです。

key: TAKA: GooD gIRL.
en: TAKA: GooD gIRL.
ja: タカ: いイ子ダ。

en: TheN fiNd a sTocK of VerDigNitE.

en: LeT us stArt bY cleaNsinG ouRselveS of thiS wreTcheD plAce.

key: TheRe's noThinG worTh rememBerIng heRe.
en: TheRe's noThinG worTh rememBerIng heRe.
ja: ここニハ覚エておク価値なンて何モなイ。

key: LUNA: I am obliged to mention that we yet lie beneath the Jasper Ward.
en: LUNA: I am obliged to mention that we yet lie beneath the Jasper Ward.
ja: ルナ: 申し上げておかねばなりませんが、わたしたちは今もジャスパー区の地下におります。

key: Should we allow the support structure to collapse, it will be the citizens who suffer for it.
en: Should we allow the support structure to collapse, it will be the citizens who suffer for it.
ja: 支持構造が崩れれば、苦しむのは市民たちです。

key: TAKA: ThaT neVer stopPed my faTheR.
en: TAKA: ThaT neVer stopPed my faTheR.
ja: タカ: そンなこトで父上ハ止マらなカっタ。

key: WhY shouLd it hoLD us bacK noW?
en: WhY shouLd it hoLD us bacK noW?
ja: なンで今、僕たチがためらうんダ?

key: TAKA: No, you're riGHT.
en: TAKA: No, you're riGHT.
ja: タカ: いヤ、君ノ言うトおりダ。

key: ThaT's toO faR-- it'S thiS aURA.
en: ThaT's toO faR-- it'S thiS aURA.
ja: それハ行きすギだ――このオーラのせイだ。

key: \PN. BreaK me oUT.
en: \PN. BreaK me oUT.
ja: \PN。僕を、ここカラ連レ出シてくレ。

key: I want oUT!
en: I want oUT!
ja: 出タいんダ!

key: LeT mY kinGdom buRN.
en: LeT mY kinGdom buRN.
ja: ワガ　オウコクヨ　モエツキロ

key: LUNA: Young Master?
en: LUNA: Young Master?
ja: ルナ: 若様?

key: TAKA: ...That stuff really does a number on you, huh.
en: TAKA: ...That stuff really does a number on you, huh.
ja: タカ: ……あれ、本当に人をおかしくするんだな。

key: LUNA: I see you are yourself once more.
en: LUNA: I see you are yourself once more.
ja: ルナ: またご自分に戻られたようですね。

key: TAKA: I feel like I was thrown out of a roller coaster and then run over by its car.
en: TAKA: I feel like I was thrown out of a roller coaster and then run over by its car.
ja: タカ: ジェットコースターから放り出されて、そのまま車体にひかれたみたいな気分だよ。

key: Please tell me that was just a very, very long bad dream.
en: Please tell me that was just a very, very long bad dream.
ja: あれがただの、とてつもなく長い悪夢だったって言ってくれよ。

key: LUNA: It was no dream.
en: LUNA: It was no dream.
ja: ルナ: 夢ではありませんでした。

key: For us, you have been gone for quite some time.
en: For us, you have been gone for quite some time.
ja: わたしたちにとっては、あなたはかなり長い間、いなくなっていたのです。

key: I am much relieved to see you well, Young Master.
en: I am much relieved to see you well, Young Master.
ja: ご無事なお姿を見て、とても安心しました、若様。

key: TAKA: Please, stop calling me...
en: TAKA: Please, stop calling me...
ja: タカ: だから、その呼び方は……

key: Wait,
en: Wait,
ja: 待って、

key: Wait, I didn't say something weird, did I?
en: Wait, I didn't say something weird, did I?
ja: 待って、僕、何か変なこと言ってなかったよな?

key: LUNA: You asked if I would still serve you and I was happy to oblige.
en: LUNA: You asked if I would still serve you and I was happy to oblige.
ja: ルナ: あなたは、わたしがまだお仕えするかとお尋ねになり、わたしは喜んでお応えしました。

key: TAKA: Oh, god, I really talked to you like that.
en: TAKA: Oh, god, I really talked to you like that.
ja: タカ: うわ、マジであんなしゃべり方してたのか。

key: Send me back into the void.
en: Send me back into the void.
ja: 虚無に送り返してくれ。

key: LUNA: Young Master, please.
en: LUNA: Young Master, please.
ja: ルナ: 若様、そんな。

key: I did not dislike it.
en: I did not dislike it.
ja: 嫌ではありませんでしたよ。

key: I'm sure there are some who would say you are better with a fire in your eyes.
en: I'm sure there are some who would say you are better with a fire in your eyes.
ja: 目に炎を宿しているあなたの方がいい、と言う人もきっといるはずです。

key: TAKA: Fire, huh...
en: TAKA: Fire, huh...
ja: タカ: 炎、か……

key: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
en: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
ja: ルナ: 失礼、何か?

key: TAKA: I almost put people in danger again...
en: TAKA: I almost put people in danger again...
ja: タカ: また、人を危険にさらすところだった……

key: LUNA: And then you snapped out of it.
en: LUNA: And then you snapped out of it.
ja: ルナ: ですが、そこから我に返られました。

key: TAKA: I will not be like my father.
en: TAKA: I will not be like my father.
ja: タカ: 僕は、父上のようにはならない。

key: The safety of the people has to come first.
en: The safety of the people has to come first.
ja: 人々の安全が何よりも優先されるべきなんだ。

key: But...
en: But...
ja: でも……

key: I suppose in a place like this, there would be no harm in a small fire.
en: I suppose in a place like this, there would be no harm in a small fire.
ja: まあ、こんな場所でなら、小さな火くらい構わないだろうけど。

key: LUNA: The walls are thorough stone. The exhaust would not be near the people.
en: LUNA: The walls are thorough stone. The exhaust would not be near the people.
ja: ルナ: 壁は隅々まで石造りです。排煙が人々に及ぶこともないでしょう。

key: Even a large inferno should be no threat.
en: Even a large inferno should be no threat.
ja: 大規模な業火であっても、脅威にはならないはずです。

key: Shall we fill the halls with oil and ash?
en: Shall we fill the halls with oil and ash?
ja: 廊下を油と灰で満たしましょうか?

key: TAKA: And seal the entrance behind us.
en: TAKA: And seal the entrance behind us.
ja: タカ: それと、僕たちの後ろで入口を封鎖してくれ。

key: LUNA: Is that an order, then?
en: LUNA: Is that an order, then?
ja: ルナ: それは、命令ということでよろしいですか?

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: Yes, it is.
en: Yes, it is.
ja: ああ、そうだ。

key: We will burn our pasts and bury the memories.
en: We will burn our pasts and bury the memories.
ja: 僕たちの過去を燃やし、思い出を埋葬しよう。

key: And then we will move on and be ourselves at last.
en: And then we will move on and be ourselves at last.
ja: そして先へ進んで、ようやく自分たち自身になるんだ。

key: LUNA: It will be as you wish, Young Master.
en: LUNA: It will be as you wish, Young Master.
ja: ルナ: 仰せのままに、若様。

key: I am relieved to see you have not lost all of your spirit.
en: I am relieved to see you have not lost all of your spirit.
ja: あなたが気概をすっかり失ってはいないと分かって、安心しました。

key: \PN, allow me to escort you outside.
en: \PN, allow me to escort you outside.
ja: \PN、外までご案内させてください。

key: I fear it will no longer be safe here in just a few scintillating moments.
en: I fear it will no longer be safe here in just a few scintillating moments.
ja: ほんの数瞬のきらめきの後には、もうここは安全ではなくなるでしょうから。

key: LUNA: May the past remain as it always should-- unrepeating and unremembered.
en: LUNA: May the past remain as it always should-- unrepeating and unremembered.
ja: ルナ: 過去は、あるべき姿のままに――繰り返されることなく、覚えられることなく。

key: Darkness take it-- and never let go.
en: Darkness take it-- and never let go.
ja: 闇よ、それを連れ去り――決して手放さないでください。

key: TAKA: May the future be brighter than any "holy light".
en: TAKA: May the future be brighter than any "holy light".
ja: タカ: どんな「聖なる光」よりも、未来が明るくありますように。

key: LUNA: With you back in it, Young Master, I believe it will.
en: LUNA: With you back in it, Young Master, I believe it will.
ja: ルナ: あなたがそこに戻られたのですから、きっとそうなると思います。

key: TAKA: Okay, but seriously?
en: TAKA: Okay, but seriously?
ja: タカ: よし、でもさ、マジで?

key: Stop calling me that.
en: Stop calling me that.
ja: その呼び方、やめてくれよ。

key: I'm older than you anyway.
en: I'm older than you anyway.
ja: だいたい、僕の方が年上なんだから。

key: LUNA: Is that--
en: LUNA: Is that--
ja: ルナ: それは――

key: TAKA: Yes, that's an order.
en: TAKA: Yes, that's an order.
ja: タカ: ああ、それは命令だ。

key: If that's what it'll take... Geez.
en: If that's what it'll take... Geez.
ja: それが必要だっていうなら……まったく。

key: ...I suppose there is no use wondering.
en: ...I suppose there is no use wondering.
ja: ……考えても仕方ありませんね。

key: Simple lamentations.
en: Simple lamentations.
ja: ただの嘆きです。

key: I meant not to trifle you with them so.
en: I meant not to trifle you with them so.
ja: あなたを煩わせるつもりはなかったのですが。

key: Our work here is finished, and so I shall return at once.
en: Our work here is finished, and so I shall return at once.
ja: ここでの用は済みましたので、すぐに戻ります。

en: Personnel Roster: Vol. 1 \nRead?
